CVE-2026-82560 is a DoS in Pod::Text when formatting attacker-controlled POD with pathological =over nesting. Pod::Text ships in perl-modules; JanusGraph debian dev variants install only perl-base and do not ship Pod/Text.pm on disk. The default workload is the Java gremlin-server entrypoint, which does not invoke pod2text. Scout maps the finding to the perl source package via the installed perl-base version.
